discovery_method: Official DTCC pages inspected in browser; direct links copied from visible download tables. Old /-/media/ paths returned 404; current links use files.dtcc.com.
scope_warning: ECS is a business line mapped to NSCC and DTC, not an independently reported financial entity. DTC financial statements include asset services and other activities. Keep entities separate and do not sum their headline figures as ECS-only profit.
release_time_note: listed_date is the date displayed on the official listing. It is not independently verified to be the first public release timestamp.
gaps: NSCC Annual 2025/2024 report appears in a legacy search result, but the legacy URL is unavailable and the current financial listing did not show it; the verified 2024/2023 report is included as an older baseline.
